name: llama-cpp
description: llama.cpp multimodal runner (llama-mtmd-cli / llama-cli) for the image-tools caption backend
installHint: Build or install llama.cpp and place llama-mtmd-cli (or llama-cli) on PATH or in ~/.vrooli/bin; see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp. No stable single-binary release is pinned, so it is not auto-fetched.
